newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Thursday it had upgraded its rating for Brazilian steel company Companhia Siderurgica Nacional S.A., or CSN, to buy from long-term buy.

-- "CSN is a massive company with a premium product mix ... and room for cost-cutting which it is exploring. Moreover, CSN has a unique opportunity in the global steel industry to integrate costs in related activities arising from privatizations in Brazil," analyst Raphael Biderman said in a report.

-- He upgraded the net profit estimate for 1996 to $227 million from $206 million. Net profits for 1997 were being revised upwards to $314 million from $261 million "to account for a more favorable price scenario," Biderman wrote.
-- The company's stock was off 0.30 to 27.70 in mid-afternoon trade.
